description:
Lot of 2: Crimson Lotus #1 and #2 (of 5) (Dark Horse, 2018), from the pages of Hellboy. Written by John Arcudi, art by Mindy Lee, colors by Michelle Madsen, covers by Tonci Zonjic. $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: Hellboy Omnibus Editions ad (both).

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
